title: Zesty Roasted Ukrainian Chinese Broccoli Skillet
description: A weeknight Ukrainian dish featuring roasted Chinese broccoli in a stone bowl, ayurvedic tamasic friendly, and made with simple ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the Chinese broccoli with olive oil, garlic, and ginger until the broccoli is evenly coated.
Spread the broccoli mixture in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 15 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and apple cider vinegar.
Remove the broccoli from the oven and stir in the soy sauce mixture, salt, and black pepper.
Return the broccoli to the oven and roast for an additional 5 minutes.
Transfer the broccoli to a stone bowl and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
